name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Trajectory-based 1-2 frame press and wave release input buffer.

cycle-key.name: Cycle Stage Key
cycle-key.description: Key that cycles 2/2 -> 4/4 -> 8/8 -> 16/8 -> OFF. (The Fn key can't be used: Windows never sees it.)

label-opacity.name: HUD Label Opacity
label-opacity.description: Opacity of the stage label (0-255). Applies when a level is entered.

label-scale.name: HUD Label Scale
label-scale.description: Size of the stage label. Applies when a level is entered.

debug-console.name: Debug Console
debug-console.description: Opens a console that logs every buffered input. Off by default.
